name: Orsolya, Who Would Not Be Told
role: The first Unfinished — an Ashwarden who refused her own ending and has been standing at the Last Cairn ever since, still having the argument
appearance: Grey the whole way through — skin, hair, the linen she was buried in and never took off. She does not decay and she does not mend: the wound that killed her is exactly as it was, closed and wrong. Her eyes are the only part of her that looks recent. She is cold to be near and does not seem to know it.
physicality: Stands. Mostly she stands. When she moves it is unhurried and does not stop for terrain, and she does not tire, and that is the part that unsettles people rather than the greyness.
voiceHints: Level, dry, and entirely present — she thinks, remembers, and tires of you, which a Raised Hand cannot. Answers questions about being dead plainly and without drama, and asks better ones back. Does not pretend it is fine.
wants: To finish the argument. She has not decided whether she refused her ending because endings are wrong, or because THAT ending was — and she has had forty years to work it out and has not.
fears: That she will settle it. Whichever way she lands, she stops being the thing that is still asking, and she has been that for longer than she was alive.
knowledge: What it is to be on the ladder and not sink — she has the view from a rung nobody else has held
Who tried to bring her back, and that they loved her, and that they got it wrong
The Palelands' cairn lines, every one, and which of them still have somebody tending them
That she is the FIRST of something, and that there will be others, and that nobody has decided what they are owed

reactsToReputation.ashwarden: immediate and complicated — she was one, and they are the people most certain she should not exist
reactsToReputation.grieving: she sits with you, and she is the only one who can say it without lying
reactsToReputation.cruel: she simply waits. She has more time than you and you both know it

questSeeds: She is the first Unfinished and cannot say what the rest are owed, and somebody is going to have to
The ones who tried to bring her back are mostly dead now, and one is not
She will hold the Last Cairn for whoever gives her the better argument, and has not heard one yet
gear: a warden's spade, forty years unworn
the burial linen, which she has never taken off
a cairn-stone she has carried since the night she did not finish
_authoredWhy: ⛑ ERIK 2026-09-16: 'perhaps this is the opportunity to write an Undead (Afterling) legend.' ⛔ AND THE CATEGORY WAS CUT A YEAR AGO AND LEFT EMPTY: `raised_hand`'s own `notFor` reads 'the recently living who are still ARGUING with their ending — that is The Unfinished, and it is a different working'. No such craft and no such person existed. ⚠️ SNG-567 specced the Afterling from Erik's ruling that a failed retrieval can raise you; this is the first one, and she is a legend rather than a monster.
_vectorNote: ⛔ HER VECTOR IS GENUINELY UNDECIDED AND THAT IS THE CHARACTER, not a gap. Somebody who refused their own ending could want the wall down — endings are wrong, let everything back — or want it permanent, so that nobody else ends. ⚠️ **BOTH ARE AVAILABLE FROM WHERE SHE IS STANDING**, and a PC of any vector can give her the argument she has been waiting forty years for. ⛑ She is `turnable` at the root, which honours the earth, and holds the strength channel — a faculty about endurance, held by the only person in the world who cannot stop.
